name: Copperfield Village
summary: Copperfield Village is a community shopping center located on Highway 6 North in northwest Houston, serving the affluent Copperfield residential area. Managed by Kimco Realty, this well-rated center provides convenient access to everyday retail, dining, and services for local families.
demographics: Copperfield Village serves the affluent northwest Houston suburban community of Copperfield, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle-income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The trade area consists largely of young professionals and established families with children, typically aged 30-55, who own homes in the surrounding master-planned communities. Shoppers in this area demonstrate strong preferences for convenience-oriented retail, quality grocery options, and family-friendly services, with frequent visits for everyday needs and weekly shopping trips. The demographic profile reflects Houston's diverse population with a mix of ethnicities and a high percentage of college-educated residents who value accessible neighborhood shopping.
description: Copperfield Village is a well-established community shopping center strategically located at 7055a Highway 6 North in the thriving Copperfield area of northwest Houston, Texas. Managed by Kimco Realty, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, this center serves as a vital retail hub for the surrounding master-planned communities. The property benefits from its prime location along Highway 6, a major north-south thoroughfare that provides excellent visibility and accessibility to the densely populated residential areas of Copperfield, Jersey Village, and Cypress. With convenient operating hours from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, Copperfield Village offers residents a mix of essential services, dining options, and retail conveniences that cater to the everyday needs of local families. The center's strong 4.4-star rating from over 2,100 reviews reflects its popularity and the quality of its tenant mix, making it a trusted destination for northwest Houston shoppers seeking a convenient and reliable neighborhood shopping experience.
